ns2:course.label: Introduction to Biophysics
ns2:course.description: Review of membrane and cell biophysics designed to introduce the theoretical and mathematical bases of bioelectricity, photobiology and biomolecular motors. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Credit is not given for BIOP 401 and PHYS 475. Prerequisite: One year each of college-level mathematics and physics; one year each of college level biology and chemistry recommended.
